item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly modifies the Harmonized Tariff Schedule to provide preferential tariff treatment and specifies when those changes apply to eligible imports. The legal consequence occurs by operation of the proclamation on the stated entry dates, with later customs administration being ministerial.","evidence":"the HTS is modified as provided in Annex I to this proclamation"}]}
